products.title: Islington Bucket
products.colour: Out of the Blue Small Classic Grain
products.description: Soft-yet-sturdy, the Islington Bucket’s refined silhouette and deep, roomy interior make it the perfect pick for everyday style. Crafted from sumptuously soft leather, it features a smart belt fastening finished with our iconic Postman’s Lock. Designed for life on the go, this easygoing bag features a robust top handle, and a long, adjustable strap for crossbody wear.
products.details: A roomy, minimalist bucket bag for everyday wear. The leather is lightly finished to protect the grain surface. This product's code is HH9390-205U939
